assumption_resolution.note: Enterprise cyber spend growth was NOT re-verified against Gartner/IDC or platform-leader guidance during the 85-day holding period. The run's data column marks this position 'blind (52d)'. Recorded unresolved rather than assumed to have held — the assumption's own falsification test (below ~5% YoY for 2 consecutive quarters) was never evaluated.

Measured at close (EUR, 2026-06-01 -> 2026-09-01, n=64d): USPY.L vs the eq-weighted held AI-capex cluster (4COP.DE + SEMI.L) rho = 0.325 daily -- just above the 0.30 assumption line, far below the inv_03 kill-switch at 0.50. Weekly over the same span is -0.00 (n=12). Pairwise: 0.276 vs copper, 0.301 vs semis, against a book-internal 0.590 copper~semis. Entry was 0.06. One daily reading above the line is not the 'sustained' breach the test requires, and the two frequencies disagree -- so: weakening, not falsified. The diversification job was substantially done for the holding period.

struct_enterprise_cyber_spend_supercycle intensity fell 85.8 (2026-07-28) -> 79.0 (2026-08-31) -> 69.3 (2026-09-01), crossing below the 70 line for ONE review; falsification requires two consecutive. narrative_maturity in the catalyst file is still 'mainstream' (the sector snapshot reads 'crowded'), not 'exhausted'. Fading clearly, falsified not yet.

outcome.catalyst_materialized_note: The driver stayed active and the vehicle delivered: USPY.L +8.6% in EUR over 85 days against a book that was behind its benchmark. struct_enterprise_cyber_spend_supercycle remains status 'active' with catalyst_alignment 71.9 at close, and no invalidation fired -- the exit is a RANKING decision (rank 8, out of a 6-name model book) and a correlation-driven rotation, not a thesis break. Two qualifiers on the 'materialized' call: (1) the mechanism itself (Gartner/IDC spend growth, platform ARR) was never re-verified after entry -- 52 days blind -- so what is confirmed is the catalyst's registered intensity trajectory, not fresh evidence of the underlying spend; (2) that trajectory is DOWN, 85.8 -> 69.3, so the driver materialized while fading. The experiment's own hypothesis (DJ-002: cyber as a durable diversifier to AI capex) is answered favourably but weakly: rho to the held cluster rose 0.06 -> 0.33, still the lowest-correlation line in the book, and the position was profitable while the cluster it hedged was not.
